# CTAIO — Chief Technology & AI Officer Network

> CTAIO is the network for Chief Technology Officers, Chief AI Officers, and VPs of Engineering. Role definitions, salary data, executive search, and weekly insight for tech leaders.

Source: https://ctaio.dev/en/

Tech leadership in the AI era

CTAIO is the network for Chief Technology Officers, Chief AI Officers, and VPs of Engineering. We document how the technology C-suite is shifting — and provide the data, frameworks, and community that tech leaders need to operate in that shift.

Our content focuses on roles that are emerging or rapidly evolving: CAIO mandates, AI governance under the EU AI Act and US executive orders, compensation benchmarks across geographies, and executive search for scaling and PE-backed contexts.

About CTAIO — who publishes it and what we publish →

Topics

Chief AI Officer (CAIO)

The definitive guide to the CAIO role: mandate, reporting lines, salary, and when to hire one.

AI Governance

Frameworks for governing AI use in mid-to-large enterprises. Model risk, shadow AI, board-level reporting.

AI Jobs

Curated senior AI and tech leadership roles, including remote-friendly positions for global candidates.

AI Newsletter

Practical AI updates for the boardroom and engineering leadership. Weekly cadence.

CTO Jobs

CTO and VP Engineering postings vetted for fit, scope, and trajectory.

Salary Data

Compensation benchmarks for CTOs, CAIOs, VPs Engineering across geographies and company stages.

Other languages

Localized content is available in German, French, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, and a starter hub in Bahasa Indonesia.

Technology leadership for the AI era.
